name: Lauri Mäkinen
bio:
Lauri's journey into motorsport finance began unexpectedly. After graduating with a degree in economics, he found himself drawn to the high-octane world after attending a local rally event. He started as an intern at a small racing team, quickly proving his aptitude for managing complex budgets and financial forecasting.

His approach to finance is meticulous and proactive. Lauri believes in building strong relationships with all team members, ensuring everyone understands the financial implications of their decisions. He's known for his ability to identify potential cost savings without compromising performance and his unflappable demeanor during high-pressure situations. What sets Lauri apart is his innovative thinking; he's constantly seeking new ways to optimize spending and secure funding opportunities, making him a valuable asset to any racing organization.

physical.description: Lauri is of average height with a lean build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen.
Drinks only herbal tea during race weekends.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the desk when deep in thought.
